topic.title: Guidance on Thermal Testing of Turbo Response

ol.li: Make sure the thermal solution is well contacted to package and will meet sustain design target.
Place system in targeted max thermal environment for turbo optimization (Example: Thermal Chamber set to 30°C)
Use PTAT to log Temperature, Frequency, Power, and Turbo Budget.
Allow system to reach thermal steady-state while at idle.
Start workload(s): PTAT thermal workload and/ or any additional workloads system designer wishes to test.
Monitor Temperature/Power/Frequency response - Wait until workload is complete or thermal steady-state is achieved.
For more details on how to design for transient performance in mobile systems refer "Thermal Design for Transient Performance - Mobile Systems Design Consideration" (#621476)
